title: Torso of a male deity
provenance: Old Talab near Bhagavati shrine of villages virnora, pernem tq. Goa.
brief_description: One Torso of a male deity.Head, hands and the below knee portion is broken. Beautifully,ornamented necklace,Yanjopavita, Katibandhaare shown on the right side of the figure .
detailed_description: Broken image of a vaishnavite deity. Head, hands and legs below the knees are broken. The sculpture is embellished with heavy ornamentation; the deity wears necklace Yajnopavita and Katibandha. An adoring female figure is depicted on the right side of the deity.
